B0CXJC5ZZT.title: SwitchBot Universal Remote Control with Hub Mini Matter Enabled, Multi-use Smart Remote with Customize App, Control 25 IR/Bluetooth Devices and 10 Scenes, Compatible with TV/AC/SwitchBot BLE Devices
bullets: Compatibility Check Before Purchase – IR & Bluetooth Limitations： Please confirm device compatibility before purchasing or contact SwitchBot Customer Support for assistance. This Universal Remote supports infrared (IR) appliances such as TVs, air conditioners, lights, fans, projectors, soundbars, and other devices that use standard IR remotes. It also supports SwitchBot Bluetooth devices and select Bluetooth TV boxes (Apple TV, Fire TV, Nvidia Shield, and standard Bluetooth TV boxes). Does not support RF remotes or most third-party Bluetooth devices.

Control Up to 25 Devices – IR + Bluetooth Combination： Control multiple devices with a single remote and reduce desktop clutter. This Universal Remote supports up to 25 devices in total (10 IR devices + 15 Bluetooth devices). Bluetooth TV boxes such as Apple TV, Fire TV, and Nvidia Shield can be paired directly via Bluetooth for basic control like power, navigation, and settings. Up to 3 Bluetooth TV boxes can be connected simultaneously. Works only with 2.4GHz Wi-Fi (not compatible with 5GHz).

Matter & Apple Home Integration (Hub Required)： To use Matter, this Universal Remote must be paired with SwitchBot Hub Mini (Matter) or Hub 2. After pairing, IR appliances and compatible SwitchBot devices can be added to Apple Home and controlled alongside other Matter products such as Philips Hue lights or IKEA blinds. Currently supported only in Apple Home. Google Home and Alexa do not support this remote device type via Matter.

Quick Setup with Large IR Code Library： Add appliances in about 10 minutes using a large infrared code library supporting nearly 100,000 appliance models, trusted by over 1 million users and continuously updated. The remote supports multiple IR learning methods including one-tap matching and key-by-key learning when used with a Hub. If your device is not listed in the code library, manual learning may be available.

User-Friendly Design & Long Battery Life： Designed with 19 simple buttons and a touch wheel for easy device switching, channel selection, and volume adjustment. Buttons are spacious and comfortable for elderly users and children. Built with a 2000mAh battery lasting up to 150 days per charge and durable buttons rated for 100,000 presses, ensuring reliable long-term use.

1-Year Warranty with Free Replacement for Quality Issues: This product comes with a 1-year warranty starting from the date of purchase. During the warranty period, if any product quality issues occur causing malfunctions or improper functioning, you can contact SwitchBot Customer Support to request a free replacement. Enjoy peace of mind with reliable after-sales support.

B0FYPR3KLW.title: SofaBaton X2 Universal Remote with Hub & Charing Dock & APP & Touchscreen
bullets: 【Unrivaled Compatibility with Vast Code Library】The SofaBaton X2 universal remote boasts an extensive and upgraded cloud code library, engineered to support over 500,000 entertainment devices over 6,000 brands. It seamlessly operates equipment using IR, Bluetooth, RF and Wi-Fi, ensuring flawless control of your TV, Soundbar, Streaming Player (Roku, Fire TV, Apple TV etc.), Cable Box, Blu-ray Player, and more. This future-proof compatibility makes it the ultimate solution to unify your entire home theater system

【Touchscreen with Quick-Access Panel】Revolutionize your remote control with SofaBaton's exclusive 2.4-inch high-definition touchscreen. The intuitive interface allows direct on-screen navigation and control, while the innovative quick-access panel beneath the display provides instant one-tap entry to digital keypads and your favorite macros. Combined with the convenient Type-C charging dock that keeps your remote powered and ready. The X2 all-in-one remote delivers unmatched convenience and modern functionality

【Seamless Home Assistant Integration】Unlock advanced smart home automation through seamless Home Assistant integration. Simply add the SofaBaton integration in your HA system to trigger activities through Home Assistant automations. This enables true cross-platform synchronization, allowing your universal remote to become an integral part of your smart home entertainment

【Dedicated Home Assistant Remote Control】Transform your SofaBaton X2 remote into a physical control terminal for Home Assistant. This feature utilizes Home Assistant's MQTT capability, allowing your HA system to subscribe to X2 remote commands and trigger supported automation functions. This integration enables direct control over more audio-video equipment, lighting, curtains and other smart home devices directly from your remote

【One-Touch Activity Control】The X2 universal remote control allows you to create Customized Activity that execute multiple commands across different devices with a single button press. Set up personalized activities like "Movie Night" (powers on TV, switches to HDMI, adjusts soundbar settings) or "Listen to Music" (activates receiver, selects audio source, sets volume) - transforming your complex home entertainment system into a seamlessly integrated smart remote that anyone can operate effortlessly

【Smart Customization via Dedicated SofaBaton APP】Unlock the full potential of your SofaBaton X2 universal remote control with the dedicated companion app. This smart remote solution allows you to create Personalized Button Layouts, program advanced Macro commands, Reassign buttons, and set up One-Touch activities (like ""Movie Night"" to control multiple devices simultaneously), and program advanced functions beyond standard remote capabilities. The intuitive APP interface makes customization effortless while storing all your preferences in the cloud for easy recovery"

【Powerful Signal Transmission with Sofabaton Hub】The X2 universal remote have powerful built-in IR blasters while the included Hub delivers 360-degree signaling with extended range, whether placed openly or hidden in cabinets ( Please use the included 2 wired IR transmitters). For whole-home coverage, optionally add single SofaBaton IR Repeaters (No inclueded package) to extend control to other rooms. Bluetooth support enables simultaneous multi-device connections and seamless switching
